record.context_brief: Diagonal torus in volume-preserving polynomial automorphisms
record.original_question: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0, let n > 1, and let k[n] = k[x1, ..., xn]. Let Aut*_k k[n] be the group of polynomial k-automorphisms with Jacobian determinant 1, and let T be the diagonal torus in Aut*_k k[n] consisting of automorphisms sigma = diag(t1, ..., tn) with sigma(x_i) = t_i x_i and t1 ... tn = 1. What are the centralizer and the normalizer of T inside Aut*_k k[n]?

evidence.quote: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0.
T := {sigma := diag(t1, . . . , tn) in Aut*_k k[n] | sigma(xi) = tixi, ti in k, product_i ti = 1}.
Problem 1.2. Describe the centralizer and the normalizer of T in Aut*_k k[n].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $0$, let $n > 1$ be an integer, and set $k^{[n]} = k[x_1, \dots, x_n]$. Let $\mathrm{Aut}^*_k\, k^{[n]}$ denote the group of $k$-algebra automorphisms $\sigma$ of $k^{[n]}$ whose Jacobian determinant $\det\bigl(\partial \sigma(x_i)/\partial x_j\bigr)$ equals $1$. Let
$$T = \{\sigma = \mathrm{diag}(t_1, \dots, t_n) \in \mathrm{Aut}^*_k\, k^{[n]} \;:\; \sigma(x_i) = t_i x_i,\ t_i \in k^\times,\ t_1 t_2 \cdots t_n = 1\}$$
be the diagonal torus inside $\mathrm{Aut}^*_k\, k^{[n]}$.

Describe explicitly the centralizer $C_{\mathrm{Aut}^*_k k^{[n]}}(T)$ and the normalizer $N_{\mathrm{Aut}^*_k k^{[n]}}(T)$ of $T$ inside $\mathrm{Aut}^*_k\, k^{[n]}$.
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not return a published result that explicitly computes the centralizer and normalizer of the diagonal Jacobian-$1$ torus inside the special automorphism group of $k^{[n]}$ for general $n>1$. The problem is posed as an open problem for a problem session, and no resolution was found among readily available sources.
